	public class DetachedObjectsHelper<T>
	{
		private class DetachedOject
		{
			public readonly Dictionary<string, object> Values;

			public DetachedOject(Dictionary<string, object> values)
			{
				Values = values;
			}

			public DetachedOject()
				: this(new Dictionary<string, object>())
			{
			}
		}

		private class DetachedPropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
		{
			internal readonly PropertyDescriptor SourceProperty;

			public override Type ComponentType => typeof(DetachedOject);

			public override bool IsReadOnly => SourceProperty.IsReadOnly;

			public override Type PropertyType => SourceProperty.PropertyType;

			private static object GetDefaultValue(Type type)
			{
				if (!type.IsValueType)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Activator.CreateInstance(type);
			}

			public DetachedPropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor property)
				: base(property.Name, property.Attributes.Cast<Attribute>().ToArray())
			{
				SourceProperty = property;
			}

			public override object GetValue(object component)
			{
				return ((DetachedOject)component).Values.GetValueOrDefault(Name, GetDefaultValue(PropertyType));
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
				((DetachedOject)component).Values[Name] = value;
			}

			public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
			{
				return false;
			}

			public override void ResetValue(object component)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private readonly string keyProperty;

		public PropertyDescriptorCollection Properties { get; }

		public static DetachedObjectsHelper<T> Create(string keyProperty, string[] properties)
		{
			return new DetachedObjectsHelper<T>(keyProperty, properties);
		}

		private DetachedObjectsHelper(string keyProperty, string[] properties)
		{
			this.keyProperty = keyProperty;
			PropertyDescriptorCollection originalProperties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(typeof(T));
			Properties = new PropertyDescriptorCollection((from x in properties.Concat(keyProperty.Yield()).Distinct()
				select new DetachedPropertyDescriptor(originalProperties[x])).ToArray());
		}

		public object GetKey(object detachedObject)
		{
			return Properties[keyProperty].GetValue(detachedObject);
		}

		public void SetKey(object detachedObject, object key)
		{
			Properties[keyProperty].SetValue(detachedObject, key);
		}

		public object[] ConvertToDetachedObjects(IEnumerable<T> source)
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<object>)source.Select(delegate(T item)
			{
				Dictionary<string, object> values = Properties.Cast<DetachedPropertyDescriptor>().ToDictionary((DetachedPropertyDescriptor property) => property.Name, (DetachedPropertyDescriptor property) => property.SourceProperty.GetValue(item));
				return new DetachedOject(values);
			})).ToArray();
		}

		public void ApplyProperties(T item, object detachedObject)
		{
			foreach (DetachedPropertyDescriptor property in Properties)
			{
				if (!property.SourceProperty.IsReadOnly)
				{
					property.SourceProperty.SetValue(item, property.GetValue(detachedObject));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class FetchRowsResult
	{
		public object[] Rows { get; private set; }

		public bool HasMoreRows { get; private set; }

		public object NextSkipToken { get; private set; }

		public static implicit operator FetchRowsResult(object[] rows)
		{
			return new FetchRowsResult(rows);
		}

		public FetchRowsResult(object[] rows, bool hasMoreRows = true, object nextSkipToken = null)
		{
			Rows = rows ?? new object[0];
			HasMoreRows = hasMoreRows;
			NextSkipToken = nextSkipToken;
		}
	}
	public sealed class SortDefinition
	{
		public string PropertyName { get; private set; }

		public ListSortDirection Direction { get; private set; }

		public SortDefinition(string propertyName, ListSortDirection direction)
		{
			PropertyName = propertyName;
			Direction = direction;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is SortDefinition sortDefinition && PropertyName == sortDefinition.PropertyName)
			{
				return Direction == sortDefinition.Direction;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = 2132011053;
			num = num * -1521134295 + EqualityComparer<string>.Default.GetHashCode(PropertyName);
			return num * -1521134295 + Direction.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public enum SummaryType
	{
		Sum,
		Avg,
		Min,
		Max,
		Count,
		Custom
	}
	public class SummaryDefinition
	{
		public string PropertyName { get; private set; }

		public SummaryType SummaryType { get; private set; }

		public object Tag { get; private set; }

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is SummaryDefinition summaryDefinition && PropertyName == summaryDefinition.PropertyName && SummaryType == summaryDefinition.SummaryType)
			{
				return object.Equals(Tag, summaryDefinition.Tag);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = -975136626;
			num = num * -1521134295 + EqualityComparer<string>.Default.GetHashCode(PropertyName);
			num = num * -1521134295 + SummaryType.GetHashCode();
			return num * -1521134295 + EqualityComparer<object>.Default.GetHashCode(Tag);
		}

		internal SummaryDefinition()
		{
		}

		public SummaryDefinition(string propertyName, SummaryType summaryType, object tag = null)
		{
			SetSummaryDefinition((summaryType != SummaryType.Count) ? propertyName : null, summaryType, tag);
		}

		internal void SetSummaryDefinition(string propertyName, SummaryType summaryType, object tag = null)
		{
			PropertyName = propertyName;
			SummaryType = summaryType;
			Tag = tag;
		}
	}
	public struct ValueAndCount : IEquatable<ValueAndCount>
	{
		public object Value { get; }

		public int Count { get; }

		public ValueAndCount(object value, int count)
		{
			Value = value;
			Count = count;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ValueAndCount))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals((ValueAndCount)obj);
		}

		public bool Equals(ValueAndCount other)
		{
			if (EqualityComparer<object>.Default.Equals(Value, other.Value))
			{
				return Count == other.Count;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = 1852890254;
			num = num * -1521134295 + EqualityComparer<object>.Default.GetHashCode(Value);
			return num * -1521134295 + Count.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Value: {Value}, Count: {Count}";
		}
	}
	public static class GridQueryableExtensions
	{
		private class QueryableToArrayHandler : IQueryableHandler<object[]>
		{
			object[] IQueryableHandler<object[]>.Handle<T>(IQueryable<T> queryable, Func<object[], object[]> transform)
			{
				object[] arg = Enumerable.Cast<object>(queryable).ToArray();
				return transform(arg);
			}
		}

		public static IQueryable<T> SortBy<T>(this IQueryable<T> source, SortDefinition[] sortOrder, string defaultUniqueSortPropertyName = null)
		{
			return source.SortBy(sortOrder, SortDefinitionHelper.MakeDefaultUniqueSort(sortOrder, defaultUniqueSortPropertyName));
		}

		public static IQueryable<T> SortBy<T>(this IQueryable<T> source, SortDefinition[] sortOrder, SortDefinition defaultUniqueSort)
		{
			sortOrder = SortDefinitionHelper.ConcatWithDefaultSortOrder(sortOrder, defaultUniqueSort);
			if (sortOrder.Length == 0)
			{
				return source;
			}
			IQueryable<T> queryable = InvokeGenericMethod(source, sortOrder.First(), "OrderBy");
			foreach (SortDefinition item in sortOrder.Skip(1))
			{
				queryable = InvokeGenericMethod(queryable, item, "ThenBy");
			}
			return queryable;
		}

		private static IOrderedQueryable<T> OrderBy<T, TProperty>(IQueryable<T> query, SortDefinition sortDescription)
		{
			Expression<Func<T, TProperty>> keySelector = ExpressionHelper.MakeMemberExpression<T, TProperty>(sortDescription.PropertyName);
			if (sortDescription.Direction != ListSortDirection.Ascending)
			{
				return query.OrderByDescending(keySelector);
			}
			return query.OrderBy(keySelector);
		}

		private static IOrderedQueryable<T> ThenBy<T, TProperty>(IOrderedQueryable<T> query, SortDefinition sortDescription)
		{
			Expression<Func<T, TProperty>> keySelector = ExpressionHelper.MakeMemberExpression<T, TProperty>(sortDescription.PropertyName);
			if (sortDescription.Direction != ListSortDirection.Ascending)
			{
				return query.ThenByDescending(keySelector);
			}
			return query.ThenBy(keySelector);
		}

		private static IQueryable<T> InvokeGenericMethod<T>(IQueryable<T> source, SortDefinition sortDescription, string methodName)
		{
			PropertyInfo[] propertyPath = ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyPath<T>(sortDescription.PropertyName);
			MethodInfo methodInfo = MakeGenericMethod<T>(typeof(GridQueryableExtensions), propertyPath.Last(), methodName);
			return (IQueryable<T>)methodInfo.Invoke(null, new object[2] { source, sortDescription });
		}

		public static object[] Distinct<T>(this IQueryable<T> queryable, string propertyName, DistinctOptions options = null)
		{
			return queryable.Distinct(propertyName, new QueryableToArrayHandler(), options);
		}

		public static TResult Distinct<T, TResult>(this IQueryable<T> queryable, string propertyName, IQueryableHandler<TResult> handler, DistinctOptions options = null)
		{
			PropertyInfo[] propertyPath = ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyPath<T>(propertyName);
			MethodInfo methodInfo = MakeGenericMethod<T>(typeof(GridQueryableExtensions), propertyPath.Last(), "GetDistinctQueryResult", new Type[1] { typeof(TResult) });
			return (TResult)methodInfo.Invoke(null, new object[4] { queryable, propertyName, handler, options });
		}

		private static TResult GetDistinctQueryResult<T, TProperty, TResult>(IQueryable<T> query, string propertyName, IQueryableHandler<TResult> handler, DistinctOptions options)
		{
			options = options ?? new DistinctOptions();
			Expression<Func<T, TProperty>> selector = ExpressionHelper.MakeMemberExpression<T, TProperty>(propertyName);
			IQueryable<TProperty> queryable = query.Select(selector).Distinct();
			if (ShouldApplyNotNull<TProperty>(options.IncludeNulls))
			{
				Expression<Func<TProperty, bool>> predicate = (TProperty x) => x != null;
				queryable = queryable.Where(predicate);
			}
			if (ShouldApplyNotEmptyString<TProperty>(options.IncludeEmptyStrings))
			{
				IQueryable<string> source = (IQueryable<string>)queryable;
				queryable = (IQueryable<TProperty>)source.Where((string x) => x != string.Empty);
			}
			queryable = ApplyOrderAndMaxCount(queryable, options.SortDirection, options.MaxCount, (TProperty x) => x);
			return handler.Handle(queryable, (object[] values) => values);
		}

		public static ValueAndCount[] DistinctWithCounts<T>(this IQueryable<T> queryable, string propertyName, DistinctOptions options = null)
		{
			PropertyInfo[] propertyPath = ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyPath<T>(propertyName);
			MethodInfo methodInfo = MakeGenericMethod<T>(typeof(GridQueryableExtensions), propertyPath.Last(), "GetDistinctWithCountsQueryResult", new Type[1] { typeof(ValueAndCount[]) });
			return (ValueAndCount[])methodInfo.Invoke(null, new object[3] { queryable, propertyName, options });
		}

		private static ValueAndCount[] GetDistinctWithCountsQueryResult<T, TProperty, TResult>(IQueryable<T> query, string propertyName, DistinctOptions options)
		{
			options = options ?? new DistinctOptions();
			Expression<Func<T, TProperty>> member = ExpressionHelper.MakeMemberExpression<T, TProperty>(propertyName);
			Action<object> action = delegate(object value)
			{
				MemberExpression left = (MemberExpression)member.Body;
				BinaryExpression body = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.NotEqual(left, System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Constant(value));
				Expression<Func<T, bool>> predicate = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda<Func<T, bool>>(body, new ParameterExpression[1] { member.Parameters.Single() });
				query = query.Where(predicate);
			};
			if (ShouldApplyNotNull<TProperty>(options.IncludeNulls))
			{
				action(null);
			}
			if (ShouldApplyNotEmptyString<TProperty>(options.IncludeEmptyStrings))
			{
				action(string.Empty);
			}
			var distinctQuery = from x in query.GroupBy(member)
				select new
				{
					Value = x.Key,
					Count = x.Count()
				};
			distinctQuery = ApplyOrderAndMaxCount(distinctQuery, options.SortDirection, options.MaxCount, x => x.Value);
			return (from x in distinctQuery.ToList()
				select new ValueAndCount(x.Value, x.Count)).ToArray();
		}

		private static bool ShouldApplyNotEmptyString<TProperty>(bool includeEmptyStrings)
		{
			if (!includeEmptyStrings)
			{
				return typeof(TProperty) == typeof(string);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ShouldApplyNotNull<TProperty>(bool includeNulls)
		{
			if (!includeNulls)
			{
				if (!(Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(typeof(TProperty)) != null))
				{
					return typeof(TProperty).IsClass;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static IQueryable<T> ApplyOrderAndMaxCount<T, TKey>(IQueryable<T> distinctQuery, ListSortDirection direction, int? maxCount, Expression<Func<T, TKey>> expression)
		{
			distinctQuery = ((direction == ListSortDirection.Ascending) ? distinctQuery.OrderBy(expression) : distinctQuery.OrderByDescending(expression));
			if (maxCount.HasValue)
			{
				distinctQuery = distinctQuery.Take(maxCount.Value);
			}
			return distinctQuery;
		}

		public static object GetSingleSummary<T>(this IQueryable<T> queryable, SummaryDefinition summary, SingleSummaryOptions options = null)
		{
			options = options ?? new SingleSummaryOptions();
			if (options.UseSortForMinMax && (summary.SummaryType == SummaryType.Min || summary.SummaryType == SummaryType.Max))
			{
				SortDefinition singleElement = new SortDefinition(summary.PropertyName, (summary.SummaryType != SummaryType.Min) ? ListSortDirection.Descending : ListSortDirection.Ascending);
				T val = queryable.SortBy(singleElement.YieldToArray()).FirstOrDefault();
				if (val == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				PropertyInfo[] propertyPath = ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyPath<T>(summary.PropertyName);
				object obj = val;
				PropertyInfo[] array = propertyPath;
				foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in array)
				{
					obj = propertyInfo.GetValue(obj);
				}
				return obj;
			}
			ParameterExpression source = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeof(IQueryable<T>), "x");
			MethodCallExpression aggregate = GetAggregate<T>(typeof(Queryable), summary, source);
			IEnumerable<object> enumerable = ((object)queryable).Yield();
			if (aggregate.Arguments.Count == 2)
			{
				LambdaExpression lambdaExpression = (LambdaExpression)((UnaryExpression)aggregate.Arguments.Last()).Operand;
				object singleElement2 = typeof(GridQueryableExtensions).GetMethod("MakeLambdaExpression", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic).MakeGenericMethod(typeof(T), lambdaExpression.ReturnType).Invoke(null, new object[1] { lambdaExpression });
				enumerable = enumerable.Concat(singleElement2.Yield());
			}
			return aggregate.Method.Invoke(null, enumerable.ToArray());
		}

		private static Expression<Func<T, TProperty>> MakeLambdaExpression<T, TProperty>(LambdaExpression lambda)
		{
			return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda<Func<T, TProperty>>(lambda.Body, lambda.Parameters);
		}

		public static object[] GetSummaries<T>(this IQueryable<T> queryable, SummaryDefinition[] summaries)
		{
			return queryable.GetSummaries(summaries, new QueryableToArrayHandler());
		}

		public static TResult GetSummaries<T, TResult>(this IQueryable<T> queryable, SummaryDefinition[] summaries, IQueryableHandler<TResult> handler)
		{
			ParameterExpression groupParameter = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeof(IGrouping<int, T>), "x");
			MethodCallExpression[] array = summaries.Select((SummaryDefinition x) => GetAggregate<T>(typeof(Enumerable), x, groupParameter)).ToArray();
			Type containerType = SummariesContainer.ContainerTypes.Value[array.Length - 1].MakeGenericType(array.Select((MethodCallExpression x) => x.Type).ToArray());
			MemberAssignment[] bindings = array.Select((MethodCallExpression x, int i) => System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Bind(containerType.GetProperty("P" + i, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public), x)).ToArray();
			MemberInitExpression memberInitExpression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.MemberInit(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.New(containerType), bindings);
			object obj = typeof(GridQueryableExtensions).GetMethod("GetSummariesContainerValue", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic).MakeGenericMethod(typeof(T), containerType, typeof(TResult)).Invoke(null, new object[5]
			{
				queryable,
				groupParameter,
				memberInitExpression,
				handler,
				summaries.Select((SummaryDefinition x) => x.SummaryType).ToArray()
			});
			return (TResult)obj;
		}

		private static MethodCallExpression GetAggregate<T>(Type rootType, SummaryDefinition summary, ParameterExpression source)
		{
			ParameterExpression lambdaParameter = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeof(T), "o");
			PropertyInfo[] input = ((summary.SummaryType != SummaryType.Count) ? ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyPath<T>(summary.PropertyName) : null);
			LambdaExpression lambda = input.With((PropertyInfo[] p) => System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda(ExpressionHelper.MakeMemberExpressionBody(p, lambdaParameter), lambdaParameter));
			return GetAggregateCall<T>(rootType, source, lambda, summary.SummaryType);
		}

		private static MethodCallExpression GetAggregateCall<T>(Type rootType, System.Linq.Expressions.Expression source, LambdaExpression lambda, SummaryType summary)
		{
			switch (summary)
			{
			case SummaryType.Sum:
				return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Call(rootType, "Sum", new Type[1] { typeof(T) }, source, lambda);
			case SummaryType.Avg:
				return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Call(rootType, "Average", new Type[1] { typeof(T) }, source, lambda);
			case SummaryType.Min:
			case SummaryType.Max:
				return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Call(rootType, summary.ToString(), new Type[2]
				{
					typeof(T),
					lambda.Body.Type
				}, source, lambda);
			case SummaryType.Count:
				return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Call(rootType, "Count", new Type[1] { typeof(T) }, source);
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		private static TResult GetSummariesContainerValue<T, TContainer, TResult>(IQueryable<T> queryable, ParameterExpression groupParameter, MemberInitExpression initExpression, IQueryableHandler<TResult> handler, SummaryType[] summaryTypes) where TContainer : class
		{
			Expression<Func<IGrouping<int, T>, TContainer>> selector = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda<Func<IGrouping<int, T>, TContainer>>(initExpression, new ParameterExpression[1] { groupParameter });
			IQueryable<TContainer> queryable2 = (from x in queryable
				group x by 0).Select(selector);
			return handler.Handle(queryable2, (object[] values) => (!values.Any()) ? summaryTypes.Select((SummaryType x) => (x == SummaryType.Sum || x == SummaryType.Count) ? ((object)0) : null).ToArray() : (from PropertyDescriptor x in TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(typeof(TContainer))
				orderby x.Name
				select x.GetValue(values.Single())).ToArray());
		}

		private static MethodInfo MakeGenericMethod<T>(Type type, PropertyInfo property, string methodName, Type[] additionalTypes = null)
		{
			Type[] array = new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(T),
				property.PropertyType
			};
			if (additionalTypes != null)
			{
				array = array.Concat(additionalTypes).ToArray();
			}
			return type.GetMethod(methodName, BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic).MakeGenericMethod(array);
		}
	}
	public interface IQueryableHandler<TResult>
	{
		TResult Handle<T>(IQueryable<T> queryable, Func<object[], object[]> transform);
	}
	public class SingleSummaryOptions
	{
		public bool UseSortForMinMax { get; private set; }

		public SingleSummaryOptions(bool useSortForMinMax = false)
		{
			UseSortForMinMax = useSortForMinMax;
		}
	}
	public class DistinctOptions
	{
		public ListSortDirection SortDirection { get; private set; }

		public int? MaxCount { get; private set; }

		public bool IncludeNulls { get; private set; }

		public bool IncludeEmptyStrings { get; private set; }

		public DistinctOptions(ListSortDirection sortDirection = ListSortDirection.Ascending, int? maxCount = null, bool includeNulls = false, bool includeEmptyStrings = false)
		{
			SortDirection = sortDirection;
			MaxCount = maxCount;
			IncludeNulls = includeNulls;
			IncludeEmptyStrings = includeEmptyStrings;
		}
	}
	public static class ExpressionHelper
	{
		private class Clojurer : ExpressionVisitor
		{
			protected override System.Linq.Expressions.Expression VisitMember(MemberExpression node)
			{
				if (node.Member is FieldInfo && node.Expression is ConstantExpression)
				{
					object value = ((ConstantExpression)node.Expression).Value;
					if (value != null && value.GetType().GetCustomAttributes(typeof(CompilerGeneratedAttribute), inherit: false).Count() > 0)
					{
						FieldInfo fieldInfo = (FieldInfo)node.Member;
						object value2 = fieldInfo.GetValue(value);
						return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Constant(value2, fieldInfo.FieldType);
					}
				}
				return base.VisitMember(node);
			}
		}

		private class ParameterReplacer : ExpressionVisitor
		{
			private readonly System.Linq.Expressions.Expression replacement;

			public ParameterReplacer(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression replacement)
			{
				this.replacement = replacement;
			}

			protected override System.Linq.Expressions.Expression VisitParameter(ParameterExpression p)
			{
				return replacement;
			}
		}

		public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> Not<T>(Expression<Func<T, bool>> expression)
		{
			return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda<Func<T, bool>>(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Not(expression.Body), expression.Parameters);
		}

		public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> And<T>(Expression<Func<T, bool>>[] operands)
		{
			return Merge(operands, System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.AndAlso);
		}

		public static Expression<Func<T, bool>> Or<T>(Expression<Func<T, bool>>[] operands)
		{
			return Merge(operands, System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.OrElse);
		}

		private static Expression<T> Merge<T>(Expression<T>[] operands, Func<System.Linq.Expressions.Expression, System.Linq.Expressions.Expression, System.Linq.Expressions.Expression> merge)
		{
			return operands.Skip(1).Aggregate(operands[0], (Expression<T> op, Expression<T> agg) => op.Merge(agg, merge));
		}

		private static Expression<T> Merge<T>(this Expression<T> first, Expression<T> second, Func<System.Linq.Expressions.Expression, System.Linq.Expressions.Expression, System.Linq.Expressions.Expression> merge)
		{
			if (first.Parameters.Count != 1 || second.Parameters.Count != 1)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			ParameterExpression replacement = first.Parameters.Single();
			System.Linq.Expressions.Expression arg = new ParameterReplacer(replacement).Visit(second.Body);
			return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda<T>(merge(first.Body, arg), first.Parameters);
		}

		public static Expression<Func<T, TResult>> Substitute<T, TProperty, TResult>(Expression<Func<TProperty, TResult>> expression, PropertyInfo[] properties)
		{
			expression = (Expression<Func<TProperty, TResult>>)new Clojurer().Visit(expression);
			Expression<Func<T, TProperty>> substitution = MakeMemberExpression<T, TProperty>(properties);
			return expression.SubstituteParameter(substitution);
		}

		public static PropertyInfo[] GetPropertyPath<T>(string propertyPath)
		{
			string[] source = propertyPath.Split('.');
			Type type = typeof(T);
			return source.Select(delegate(string propertyName)
			{
				PropertyInfo property = GetProperty(type, propertyName);
				type = property.PropertyType;
				return property;
			}).ToArray();
		}

		public static PropertyInfo GetProperty(Type type, string propertyName)
		{
			PropertyInfo propertyCore = GetPropertyCore(type, propertyName);
			if (!(propertyCore.DeclaringType == propertyCore.ReflectedType))
			{
				return GetPropertyCore(propertyCore.DeclaringType, propertyName);
			}
			return propertyCore;
		}

		private static PropertyInfo GetPropertyCore(Type type, string propertyName)
		{
			return type.GetProperty(propertyName, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
		}

		private static Expression<Func<T2, TResult>> SubstituteParameter<T1, T2, TResult>(this Expression<Func<T1, TResult>> expression, Expression<Func<T2, T1>> substitution)
		{
			System.Linq.Expressions.Expression body = new ParameterReplacer(substitution.Body).Visit(expression.Body);
			return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda<Func<T2, TResult>>(body, substitution.Parameters);
		}

		public static Expression<Func<T, TResult>> MakeMemberExpression<T, TResult>(string propertyName)
		{
			return MakeMemberExpression<T, TResult>(GetPropertyPath<T>(propertyName));
		}

		public static Expression<Func<T, TResult>> MakeMemberExpression<T, TResult>(PropertyInfo[] properties)
		{
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeof(T), "x");
			System.Linq.Expressions.Expression expression = MakeMemberExpressionBody(properties, parameterExpression);
			if (typeof(TResult) != properties.Last().PropertyType)
			{
				expression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Convert(expression, typeof(TResult));
			}
			return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda<Func<T, TResult>>(expression, new ParameterExpression[1] { parameterExpression });
		}

		public static System.Linq.Expressions.Expression MakeMemberExpressionBody(PropertyInfo[] properties, ParameterExpression parameter)
		{
			System.Linq.Expressions.Expression expression = parameter;
			foreach (PropertyInfo property in properties)
			{
				expression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Property(expression, property);
			}
			return expression;
		}
	}
}

	public static class SortDefinitionHelper
	{
		public static SortDefinition[] ConcatWithDefaultSortOrder(SortDefinition[] sortOrder, SortDefinition defaultUniqueSort)
		{
			if (defaultUniqueSort != null && !sortOrder.Any((SortDefinition x) => defaultUniqueSort.PropertyName == x.PropertyName))
			{
				sortOrder = sortOrder.Concat(defaultUniqueSort.Yield()).ToArray();
			}
			return sortOrder;
		}

		public static SortDefinition MakeDefaultUniqueSort(SortDefinition[] sortOrder, string defaultUniqueSortPropertyName)
		{
			SortDefinition sortDefinition = sortOrder.LastOrDefault();
			return (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(defaultUniqueSortPropertyName)) ? new SortDefinition(defaultUniqueSortPropertyName, sortDefinition?.Direction ?? ListSortDirection.Ascending) : null;
		}
	}

	internal class DefaultServiceContainer : ServiceContainer
	{
		public DefaultServiceContainer()
			: base(null)
		{
		}

		protected virtual ResourceDictionary GetApplicationResources()
		{
			if (!Application.Current.Return((Application x) => x.Dispatcher.CheckAccess(), () => false))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Application.Current.Resources;
		}

		private Dictionary<string, object> GetApplicationResources(Type type)
		{
			ResourceDictionary appResources = GetApplicationResources();
			if (appResources == null)
			{
				return new Dictionary<string, object>();
			}
			return (from x in appResources.Keys.OfType<string>().ToDictionary((string x) => x, (string x) => appResources[x])
				where x.Value != null && type.IsAssignableFrom(x.Value.GetType())
				select x).ToDictionary((KeyValuePair<string, object> x) => x.Key, (KeyValuePair<string, object> x) => x.Value);
		}

		protected override object GetServiceCore(Type type, string key, ServiceSearchMode searchMode, out bool serviceHasKey)
		{
			object serviceCore = base.GetServiceCore(type, key, searchMode, out serviceHasKey);
			if (serviceCore != null)
			{
				return serviceCore;
			}
			Dictionary<string, object> applicationResources = GetApplicationResources(type);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) && applicationResources.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return applicationResources[key];
			}
			serviceHasKey = true;
			return applicationResources.FirstOrDefault().Value;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<object> GetServicesCore(Type type, bool localOnly)
		{
			foreach (object item in base.GetServicesCore(type, localOnly))
			{
				yield return item;
			}
			foreach (object value in GetApplicationResources(type).Values)
			{
				yield return value;
			}
		}
	}

		private static Tuple<string, string> GetApplicationName()
		{
			string text = "";
			string text2 = "";
			try
			{
				if (Application.Current != null)
				{
					Type type = ((Application.Current.MainWindow != null) ? Application.Current.MainWindow.GetType() : Application.Current.GetType());
					object[] customAttributes = type.Assembly.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: true);
					AssemblyProductAttribute assemblyProductAttribute = customAttributes.OfType<AssemblyProductAttribute>().FirstOrDefault();
					AssemblyVersionAttribute assemblyVersionAttribute = customAttributes.OfType<AssemblyVersionAttribute>().FirstOrDefault();
					if (assemblyProductAttribute != null)
					{
						text = assemblyProductAttribute.Product;
					}
					if (assemblyVersionAttribute != null)
					{
						text2 = assemblyVersionAttribute.Version;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (text.Length == 0 || text2.Length == 0)
			{
				try
				{
					Assembly entryAssembly = Assembly.GetEntryAssembly();
					if (entryAssembly != null)
					{
						AssemblyName name = entryAssembly.GetName();
						if (text.Length == 0)
						{
							text = name.Name;
						}
						if (text2.Length == 0)
						{
							text2 = name.Version.ToString();
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return new Tuple<string, string>(text, text2);
		}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(DateTimeRangeTypeConverter))]
	public struct DateTimeRange : IFormattable, IEquatable<DateTimeRange>
	{
		private static readonly string[] DefaultDateTimeDelimeter = new string[1] { ")-(" };

		internal static readonly string DefaultFormat = "({0})-({1})";

		private static readonly DateTimeRange empty = new DateTimeRange(DateTime.MinValue, DateTime.MinValue);

		private DateTime start;

		private DateTime end;

		public static DateTimeRange Empty => empty;

		public static DateTimeRange Today => new DateTimeRange(DateTime.Now.Date, TimeSpan.FromDays(1.0));

		public DateTime Start => start;

		public DateTime End => end;

		public bool IsEmpty => Equals(empty);

		public bool IsValid => start <= end;

		public TimeSpan Duration => end - start;

		public static bool operator ==(DateTimeRange x, DateTimeRange y)
		{
			return x.Equals(y);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DateTimeRange x, DateTimeRange y)
		{
			return !x.Equals(y);
		}

		public static DateTimeRange Union(DateTimeRange x, DateTimeRange y)
		{
			if (x.IsEmpty)
			{
				return y;
			}
			if (y.IsEmpty)
			{
				return x;
			}
			long ticks = Math.Min(x.start.Ticks, y.start.Ticks);
			long ticks2 = Math.Max(x.end.Ticks, y.end.Ticks);
			return new DateTimeRange(new DateTime(ticks), new DateTime(ticks2));
		}

		public static DateTimeRange Intersect(DateTimeRange x, DateTimeRange y, bool includeBounds = true)
		{
			long num = Math.Max(x.start.Ticks, y.start.Ticks);
			long num2 = Math.Min(x.end.Ticks, y.end.Ticks);
			bool num3;
			if (!includeBounds)
			{
				if (x.start == y.start)
				{
					goto IL_006c;
				}
				num3 = num2 > num;
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = num2 >= num;
			}
			if (!num3)
			{
				return Empty;
			}
			goto IL_006c;
			IL_006c:
			return new DateTimeRange(new DateTime(num), new DateTime(num2));
		}

		public static bool IntersectsWith(DateTimeRange x, DateTimeRange y, bool includeBounds = true)
		{
			if (includeBounds)
			{
				if (x.End >= y.Start)
				{
					return x.Start <= y.End;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (!(x.End > y.Start) || !(x.Start < y.End))
			{
				return x.Start == y.Start;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool TryParse(string input, CultureInfo culture, out DateTimeRange result)
		{
			string[] array = input.Split(DefaultDateTimeDelimeter, StringSplitOptions.None);
			if (array.Length == 2 && TryParse(array[0].Replace("(", ""), culture, out DateTime result2) && TryParse(array[1].Replace(")", ""), culture, out DateTime result3))
			{
				result = new DateTimeRange(result2, result3);
				return true;
			}
			result = Empty;
			return false;
		}

		private static bool TryParse(string value, CultureInfo culture, out DateTime result)
		{
			try
			{
				result = Convert.ToDateTime(value, culture);
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				result = DateTime.Today;
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DateTimeRange(DateTime start, TimeSpan duration)
		{
			this.start = start;
			if (duration.Ticks >= 0)
			{
				end = ((duration.Ticks > DateTime.MaxValue.Ticks - start.Ticks) ? DateTime.MaxValue : start.Add(duration));
			}
			else if (duration == TimeSpan.MinValue || duration.Negate().Ticks > start.Ticks)
			{
				end = DateTime.MinValue;
			}
			else
			{
				end = start.Add(duration);
			}
		}

		public DateTimeRange(DateTime start, DateTime end)
		{
			this.start = start;
			this.end = end;
		}

		public DateTimeRange(DateTimeRange source)
		{
			start = source.start;
			end = source.end;
		}

		public DateTimeRange Union(DateTimeRange x)
		{
			return Union(this, x);
		}

		public DateTimeRange Intersect(DateTimeRange x, bool includeBounds = true)
		{
			return Intersect(this, x, includeBounds);
		}

		public bool IntersectsWith(DateTimeRange x, bool includeBounds = true)
		{
			return IntersectsWith(this, x, includeBounds);
		}

		public bool Contains(DateTime date, bool includeRangeEnd = false)
		{
			if (start == end)
			{
				return date == start;
			}
			if (includeRangeEnd)
			{
				if (date >= start)
				{
					return date <= end;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (date >= start)
			{
				return date < end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(DateTimeRange x)
		{
			if (start == end && x.start == x.end)
			{
				return start == x.start;
			}
			if (x.start >= end)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.start >= start)
			{
				return x.end <= end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DateTimeRange))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals((DateTimeRange)obj);
		}

		public bool Equals(DateTimeRange other)
		{
			if (start == other.start)
			{
				return end == other.end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int hashCode = start.GetHashCode();
			return (((hashCode >> 24) & 0xFF) | ((hashCode >> 8) & 0xFF00) | ((hashCode << 8) & 0xFF0000) | (int)((hashCode << 24) & 0xFF000000u)) ^ end.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(DefaultFormat, start, end);
		}

		public string ToString(IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			if (provider != null)
			{
				return ToStringCore(DefaultFormat, provider);
			}
			return ToString();
		}

		public string ToString(string format, IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(format))
			{
				format = DefaultFormat;
			}
			if (provider == null)
			{
				return string.Format(format, start, end);
			}
			return ToStringCore(format, provider);
		}

		private string ToStringCore(string format, IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			if (!(provider.GetFormat(typeof(ICustomFormatter)) is ICustomFormatter customFormatter))
			{
				return string.Format(format, start.ToString(provider), end.ToString(provider));
			}
			return customFormatter.Format(format, this, provider);
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(TimeSpanRangeTypeConverter))]
	public struct TimeSpanRange : IFormattable, IEquatable<TimeSpanRange>
	{
		internal static readonly string DefaultTimeSpanFormat = "d\\.hh\\:mm\\:ss\\.fff";

		private static readonly char DefaultTimeSpanDelimeter = '-';

		internal static readonly string DefaultFormat = "{0}-{1}";

		private static readonly TimeSpanRange zero = new TimeSpanRange(TimeSpan.Zero, TimeSpan.Zero);

		private static readonly TimeSpanRange day = new TimeSpanRange(TimeSpan.Zero, TimeSpan.FromDays(1.0));

		private readonly TimeSpan start;

		private readonly TimeSpan end;

		public static TimeSpanRange Zero => zero;

		public static TimeSpanRange Day => day;

		public TimeSpan Start => start;

		public TimeSpan End => end;

		public TimeSpan Duration => end - start;

		public bool IsZero => Equals(zero);

		public bool IsDay => Equals(day);

		public bool IsValid => start <= end;

		public static bool operator ==(TimeSpanRange x, TimeSpanRange y)
		{
			return x.Equals(y);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(TimeSpanRange x, TimeSpanRange y)
		{
			return !x.Equals(y);
		}

		public static TimeSpanRange Union(TimeSpanRange x, TimeSpanRange y)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = ((x.start < y.start) ? x.start : y.start);
			TimeSpan timeSpan2 = ((x.end > y.end) ? x.end : y.end);
			return new TimeSpanRange(timeSpan, timeSpan2);
		}

		public static TimeSpanRange Intersect(TimeSpanRange x, TimeSpanRange y, bool includeBounds = true)
		{
			TimeSpan timeSpan = ((x.start > y.start) ? x.start : y.start);
			TimeSpan timeSpan2 = ((x.end < y.end) ? x.end : y.end);
			bool num;
			if (!includeBounds)
			{
				if (x.start == y.start)
				{
					goto IL_0077;
				}
				num = timeSpan2 > timeSpan;
			}
			else
			{
				num = timeSpan2 >= timeSpan;
			}
			if (!num)
			{
				return Zero;
			}
			goto IL_0077;
			IL_0077:
			return new TimeSpanRange(timeSpan, timeSpan2);
		}

		public static bool IntersectsWith(TimeSpanRange x, TimeSpanRange y, bool includeBounds = true)
		{
			if (includeBounds)
			{
				if (x.End >= y.Start)
				{
					return x.Start <= y.End;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (!(x.End > y.Start) || !(x.Start < y.End))
			{
				return x.Start == y.Start;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static TimeSpanRange Parse(string input, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!TryParse(input, culture, out var result))
			{
				throw new FormatException();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool TryParse(string input, CultureInfo culture, out TimeSpanRange result)
		{
			string[] array = input.Split(DefaultTimeSpanDelimeter);
			if (array.Length == 2 && TimeSpan.TryParse(array[0], culture, out var result2) && TimeSpan.TryParse(array[1], culture, out var result3))
			{
				result = new TimeSpanRange(result2, result3);
				return true;
			}
			result = zero;
			return false;
		}

		public TimeSpanRange(TimeSpan start, TimeSpan end)
		{
			this.start = start;
			this.end = end;
		}

		public TimeSpanRange Union(TimeSpanRange x)
		{
			return Union(this, x);
		}

		public bool Contains(TimeSpan time, bool includeRangeEnd = false)
		{
			if (start == end)
			{
				return time == start;
			}
			if (includeRangeEnd)
			{
				if (time >= start)
				{
					return time <= end;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (time >= start)
			{
				return time < end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(TimeSpanRange x)
		{
			if (start == end && x.start == x.end)
			{
				return start == x.start;
			}
			if (x.start >= end)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.start >= start)
			{
				return x.end <= end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public TimeSpanRange Intersect(TimeSpanRange x, bool includeBounds = true)
		{
			return Intersect(this, x, includeBounds);
		}

		public bool IntersectsWith(TimeSpanRange x, bool includeBounds = true)
		{
			return IntersectsWith(this, x, includeBounds);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is TimeSpanRange))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals((TimeSpanRange)obj);
		}

		public bool Equals(TimeSpanRange other)
		{
			if (start == other.start)
			{
				return end == other.end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int hashCode = start.GetHashCode();
			return (((hashCode >> 24) & 0xFF) | ((hashCode >> 8) & 0xFF00) | ((hashCode << 8) & 0xFF0000) | (int)((hashCode << 24) & 0xFF000000u)) ^ end.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(DefaultFormat, start.ToString(DefaultTimeSpanFormat), end.ToString(DefaultTimeSpanFormat));
		}

		public string ToString(IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			if (provider != null)
			{
				return ToStringCore(DefaultFormat, provider);
			}
			return ToString();
		}

		public string ToString(string format, IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(format))
			{
				format = DefaultFormat;
			}
			if (provider == null)
			{
				return string.Format(format, start.ToString(DefaultTimeSpanFormat), end.ToString(DefaultTimeSpanFormat));
			}
			return ToStringCore(format, provider);
		}

		private string ToStringCore(string format, IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			if (!(provider.GetFormat(typeof(ICustomFormatter)) is ICustomFormatter customFormatter))
			{
				return string.Format(format, start.ToString(DefaultTimeSpanFormat, provider), end.ToString(DefaultTimeSpanFormat, provider));
			}
			return customFormatter.Format(format, this, provider);
		}
	}

	public enum ViewInjectionMode

	public class ViewInjectionManager : IViewInjectionManager
	{
		private class ServiceManagerHelper
		{
			private readonly List<WeakReference> ServiceReferences = new List<WeakReference>();

			private void UpdateServiceReferences()
			{
				List<WeakReference> list = new List<WeakReference>();
				foreach (WeakReference serviceReference in ServiceReferences)
				{
					if (!serviceReference.IsAlive)
					{
						list.Add(serviceReference);
					}
				}
				foreach (WeakReference item in list)
				{
					ServiceReferences.Remove(item);
				}
			}

			private WeakReference GetServiceReference(IViewInjectionService service)
			{
				UpdateServiceReferences();
				return ServiceReferences.FirstOrDefault((WeakReference x) => x.Target == service);
			}

			public void Add(IViewInjectionService service)
			{
				if (service != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(service.RegionName) && GetServiceReference(service) == null)
				{
					if (FindService((IViewInjectionService x) => x.RegionName == service.RegionName) != null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot register services with the same RegionName");
					}
					ServiceReferences.Add(new WeakReference(service));
				}
			}

			public void Remove(IViewInjectionService service)
			{
				if (service != null)
				{
					WeakReference serviceReference = GetServiceReference(service);
					if (serviceReference != null)
					{
						ServiceReferences.Remove(serviceReference);
					}
				}
			}

			public IViewInjectionService FindService(Func<IViewInjectionService, bool> predicate)
			{
				UpdateServiceReferences();
				WeakReference weakReference = ServiceReferences.FirstOrDefault((WeakReference x) => predicate((IViewInjectionService)x.Target));
				if (weakReference == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (IViewInjectionService)weakReference.Target;
			}

			public IEnumerable<IViewInjectionService> FindAllServices(Func<IViewInjectionService, bool> predicate)
			{
				List<IViewInjectionService> list = new List<IViewInjectionService>();
				UpdateServiceReferences();
				List<WeakReference> list2 = ServiceReferences.FindAll((WeakReference x) => predicate((IViewInjectionService)x.Target));
				foreach (WeakReference item in list2)
				{
					list.Add((IViewInjectionService)item.Target);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private class QueueManagerHelper
		{
			private class InjectionItem
			{
				public string RegionName { get; private set; }

				public object Key { get; private set; }

				public Func<object> Factory { get; private set; }

				public string ViewName { get; private set; }

				public Type ViewType { get; private set; }

				public InjectionItem(string regionName, object key, Func<object> factory, string viewName, Type viewType)
				{
					RegionName = regionName;
					Key = key;
					Factory = factory;
					ViewName = viewName;
					ViewType = viewType;
				}
			}

			private class NavigationItem
			{
				public readonly string RegionName;

				public readonly object Key;

				public NavigationItem(string regionName, object key)
				{
					RegionName = regionName;
					Key = key;
				}
			}

			private ViewInjectionManager Owner;

			private readonly List<InjectionItem> InjectionQueue = new List<InjectionItem>();

			private readonly List<InjectionItem> PersistentInjectionQueue = new List<InjectionItem>();

			private readonly List<NavigationItem> NavigationQueue = new List<NavigationItem>();

			public QueueManagerHelper(ViewInjectionManager owner)
			{
				Owner = owner;
			}

			public void PutToInjectionQueue(string regionName, object key, Func<object> factory, string viewName, Type viewType)
			{
				InjectionQueue.Add(new InjectionItem(regionName, key, factory, viewName, viewType));
			}

			public void PutToPersistentInjectionQueue(string regionName, object key, Func<object> factory, string viewName, Type viewType)
			{
				foreach (InjectionItem item in PersistentInjectionQueue)
				{
					if (item.RegionName == regionName && object.Equals(item.Key, key))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot inject item with this key, because it already exists in this region.");
					}
				}
				PersistentInjectionQueue.Add(new InjectionItem(regionName, key, factory, viewName, viewType));
			}

			public void PutToNavigationQueue(string regionName, object key)
			{
				NavigationQueue.Add(new NavigationItem(regionName, key));
			}

			public void RemoveFromQueues(string regionName, object key)
			{
				InjectionItem input = InjectionQueue.FirstOrDefault((InjectionItem x) => x.RegionName == regionName && object.Equals(x.Key, key));
				input.Do(delegate(InjectionItem x)
				{
					InjectionQueue.Remove(x);
				});
				InjectionItem input2 = PersistentInjectionQueue.FirstOrDefault((InjectionItem x) => x.RegionName == regionName && object.Equals(x.Key, key));
				input2.Do(delegate(InjectionItem x)
				{
					PersistentInjectionQueue.Remove(x);
				});
				NavigationItem input3 = NavigationQueue.FirstOrDefault((NavigationItem x) => x.RegionName == regionName && object.Equals(x.Key, key));
				input3.Do(delegate(NavigationItem x)
				{
					NavigationQueue.Remove(x);
				});
			}

			public void UpdateQueues()
			{
				ProcessQueue(InjectionQueue, (InjectionItem x) => Owner.InjectCore(x.RegionName, x.Key, x.Factory, x.ViewName, x.ViewType));
				ProcessQueue(PersistentInjectionQueue, delegate(InjectionItem x)
				{
					Owner.InjectCore(x.RegionName, x.Key, x.Factory, x.ViewName, x.ViewType);
					return false;
				});
				ProcessQueue(NavigationQueue, (NavigationItem x) => Owner.NavigateCore(x.RegionName, x.Key));
			}

			private void ProcessQueue<T>(IList<T> queue, Func<T, bool> processAction)
			{
				List<T> list = new List<T>();
				foreach (T item in queue.ToList())
				{
					if (processAction(item))
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				foreach (T item2 in list)
				{
					queue.Remove(item2);
				}
			}
		}

		private class MessengerEx : Messenger
		{
			public MessengerEx()
				: base(isMultiThreadSafe: false)
			{
			}

			public void Register<TMessage>(object recipient, object token, bool receiveInheritedMessages, Action action)
			{
				IActionInvoker actionInvoker = CreateActionInvoker<TMessage>(recipient, action);
				RegisterCore(token, receiveInheritedMessages, typeof(TMessage), actionInvoker);
				RequestCleanup();
			}

			public void Unregister<TMessage>(object recipient, object token, Action action)
			{
				UnregisterCore(recipient, token, action, typeof(TMessage));
			}

			private IActionInvoker CreateActionInvoker<TMessage>(object recipient, Action action)
			{
				if (action.Method.IsStatic)
				{
					return new StrongReferenceActionInvoker(recipient, action);
				}
				return new WeakReferenceActionInvoker(recipient, action);
			}
		}

		internal class ViewInjectionServiceException : Exception

			private const string _viewInjectionManager_CannotResolveViewModel = "ViewModelLocator cannot resolve a view model (the view model name is {0}).";

			private const string _viewInjectionService_ViewModelAlreadyExists = "A view model with the same key already exists.";

			private const string _strategyManager_NoStrategy = "Cannot find an appropriate strategy for the {0} container type.";

			private const string _invalidSelectedViewModel = "Cannot set the SelectedViewModel property to a value that does not exist in the ViewModels collection. Inject the view model before selecting it.";

			private const string _contentControl_ContentAlreadySet = "It is impossible to use ViewInjectionService for the control that has the Content property set.";

			private const string _itemsControl_ItemsSourceAlreadySet = "It is impossible to use ViewInjectionService for the control that has the ItemsSource property set.";

		private const string Exception1 = "Cannot register services with the same RegionName";

		private const string Exception2 = "Cannot inject item with this key, because it already exists in this region.";

		private static IViewInjectionManager _defaultInstance = new ViewInjectionManager(ViewInjectionMode.Default);

		private static IViewInjectionManager _default;

		private static IViewInjectionManager _persistentManager = new ViewInjectionManager(ViewInjectionMode.Persistent);

		private ServiceManagerHelper ServiceManager;

		private QueueManagerHelper QueueManager;

		private MessengerEx Messenger;

		public static IViewInjectionManager Default
		{
			get
			{
				return _default ?? _defaultInstance;
			}
			set
			{
				_default = value;
			}
		}

		public static IViewInjectionManager PersistentManager => _persistentManager;

		protected ViewInjectionMode Mode { get; private set; }

		public virtual void RegisterService(IViewInjectionService service)
		{
			ServiceManager.Add(service);
			QueueManager.UpdateQueues();
		}

		public virtual void UnregisterService(IViewInjectionService service)
		{
			ServiceManager.Remove(service);
			if (Mode != ViewInjectionMode.Persistent)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in service.ViewModels.ToList())
			{
				service.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		public IViewInjectionService GetService(string regionName)
		{
			return ServiceManager.FindService((IViewInjectionService x) => x.RegionName == regionName);
		}

		public virtual void Inject(string regionName, object key, Func<object> viewModelFactory, string viewName, Type viewType)
		{
			bool flag = InjectCore(regionName, key, viewModelFactory, viewName, viewType);
			if (Mode == ViewInjectionMode.Persistent)
			{
				QueueManager.PutToPersistentInjectionQueue(regionName, key, viewModelFactory, viewName, viewType);
			}
			else if (!flag)
			{
				QueueManager.PutToInjectionQueue(regionName, key, viewModelFactory, viewName, viewType);
			}
			QueueManager.UpdateQueues();
		}

		protected bool InjectCore(string regionName, object key, Func<object> factory, string viewName, Type viewType)
		{
			IViewInjectionService service = GetService(regionName);
			if (service != null)
			{
				if (Mode == ViewInjectionMode.Persistent && service.GetViewModel(key) != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				service.Inject(key, factory(), viewName, viewType);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void Remove(string regionName, object key)
		{
			QueueManager.RemoveFromQueues(regionName, key);
			IViewInjectionService service = GetService(regionName);
			service?.Remove(service.GetViewModel(key));
		}

		public virtual void Navigate(string regionName, object key)
		{
			if (!NavigateCore(regionName, key))
			{
				QueueManager.PutToNavigationQueue(regionName, key);
			}
		}

		protected bool NavigateCore(string regionName, object key)
		{
			IViewInjectionService service = GetService(regionName);
			if (service == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object viewModel = service.GetViewModel(key);
			if (viewModel != null)
			{
				service.SelectedViewModel = viewModel;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void RegisterNavigatedEventHandler(object viewModel, Action eventHandler)
		{
			Messenger.Register<NavigatedMessage>(viewModel, viewModel.GetHashCode(), receiveInheritedMessages: false, eventHandler);
		}

		public void RegisterNavigatedAwayEventHandler(object viewModel, Action eventHandler)
		{
			Messenger.Register<NavigatedAwayMessage>(viewModel, viewModel.GetHashCode(), receiveInheritedMessages: false, eventHandler);
		}

		public void RegisterViewModelClosingEventHandler(object viewModel, Action<ViewModelClosingEventArgs> eventHandler)
		{
			Messenger.Register(viewModel, viewModel.GetHashCode(), receiveInheritedMessages: false, eventHandler);
		}

		public void UnregisterNavigatedEventHandler(object viewModel, Action eventHandler = null)
		{
			Messenger.Unregister<NavigatedMessage>(viewModel, viewModel.GetHashCode(), eventHandler);
		}

		public void UnregisterNavigatedAwayEventHandler(object viewModel, Action eventHandler = null)
		{
			Messenger.Unregister<NavigatedAwayMessage>(viewModel, viewModel.GetHashCode(), eventHandler);
		}

		public void UnregisterViewModelClosingEventHandler(object viewModel, Action<ViewModelClosingEventArgs> eventHandler = null)
		{
			Messenger.Unregister(viewModel, viewModel.GetHashCode(), eventHandler);
		}

		public void RaiseNavigatedEvent(object viewModel)
		{
			Messenger.Send(new NavigatedMessage(), viewModel.GetHashCode());
		}

		public void RaiseNavigatedAwayEvent(object viewModel)
		{
			Messenger.Send(new NavigatedAwayMessage(), viewModel.GetHashCode());
		}

		public void RaiseViewModelClosingEvent(ViewModelClosingEventArgs e)
		{
			Messenger.Send(e, e.ViewModel.GetHashCode());
		}

		public ViewInjectionManager(ViewInjectionMode mode)
		{
			Mode = mode;
			ServiceManager = new ServiceManagerHelper();
			QueueManager = new QueueManagerHelper(this);
			Messenger = new MessengerEx();
		}
	}

	{

		object DeserializeState(string state, Type stateType);

	public class StateSerializer : IStateSerializer
	{
		private static IStateSerializer _defaultInstance = new StateSerializer();

		private static IStateSerializer _default;

		public static IStateSerializer Default
		{
			get
			{
				return _default ?? _defaultInstance;
			}
			set
			{
				_default = value;
			}
		}

		public string SerializeState(object state, Type stateType)
		{
			string result = null;
			if (state == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return SerializationHelper.SerializeToString(delegate(Stream x)
			{
				XmlSerializerHelper.Serialize(x, state, state.GetType());
			});
		}

		public object DeserializeState(string state, Type stateType)
		{
			object res = null;
			SerializationHelper.DeserializeFromString(state, (Stream x) => res = XmlSerializerHelper.Deserialize(x, stateType));
			return res;
		}
	}
	public abstract class LocatorBase
	{
		private static Assembly entryAssembly;

		private Dictionary<string, Type> registeredTypes = new Dictionary<string, Type>();

		private Dictionary<string, Type> shortNameToTypeMapping = new Dictionary<string, Type>();

		private Dictionary<string, Type> fullNameToTypeMapping = new Dictionary<string, Type>();

		private IEnumerator<Type> enumerator;

		protected static Assembly EntryAssembly
		{
			get
			{
				if (entryAssembly == null)
				{
					entryAssembly = Assembly.GetEntryAssembly();
				}
				return entryAssembly;
			}
			set
			{
				entryAssembly = value;
			}
		}

		protected abstract IEnumerable<Assembly> Assemblies { get; }

		public void RegisterType(string name, Type type)
		{
			registeredTypes.Add(name, type);
		}

		protected Type ResolveType(string name, out IDictionary<string, string> properties)
		{
			ResolveTypeProperties(ref name, out properties);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (registeredTypes.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (shortNameToTypeMapping.TryGetValue(name, out value) || fullNameToTypeMapping.TryGetValue(name, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (enumerator == null)
			{
				enumerator = GetTypes();
			}
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (!fullNameToTypeMapping.ContainsKey(enumerator.Current.FullName))
				{
					shortNameToTypeMapping[enumerator.Current.Name] = enumerator.Current;
					fullNameToTypeMapping[enumerator.Current.FullName] = enumerator.Current;
				}
				if (enumerator.Current.Name == name || enumerator.Current.FullName == name)
				{
					return enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected string ResolveTypeName(Type type, IDictionary<string, string> properties)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = CreateTypeProperties(properties);
			return text + type.FullName;
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerator<Type> GetTypes()
		{
			foreach (Assembly assembly in Assemblies)
			{
				_ = new Type[0];
				Type[] types;
				try
				{
					types = assembly.GetTypes();
				}
				catch (ReflectionTypeLoadException ex)
				{
					types = ex.Types;
				}
				Type[] array = types;
				foreach (Type type in array)
				{
					if (type != null)
					{
						yield return type;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected static void ResolveTypeProperties(ref string name, out IDictionary<string, string> properties)
		{
			Func<string, string> func = delegate(string x)
			{
				int num = x.IndexOf('=');
				return (num != -1) ? x.Substring(0, num) : null;
			};
			Func<string, string> func2 = delegate(string x)
			{
				int num = x.IndexOf('=');
				int num2 = x.IndexOf(';');
				return (num == -1 || num2 == -1) ? null : x.Substring(num + 1, num2 - num - 1);
			};
			Func<string, string> func3 = delegate(string x)
			{
				int num = x.IndexOf(';');
				return x.Remove(0, num + 1);
			};
			properties = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				string text = func(name);
				string text2 = func2(name);
				if (text != null && text2 != null)
				{
					properties.Add(text, text2);
					name = func3(name);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected static string CreateTypeProperties(IDictionary<string, string> properties)
		{
			if (properties == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> property in properties)
			{
				text += property.Key;
				text += "=";
				text += property.Value;
				text += ";";
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected virtual object CreateInstance(Type type, string typeName)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = null;
			try
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor = type.GetConstructor(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.CreateInstance, null, new Type[0], null);
				if (constructor != null)
				{
					obj = constructor.Invoke(null);
				}
				if (obj == null)
				{
					obj = Activator.CreateInstance(type, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.CreateInstance | BindingFlags.OptionalParamBinding, null, null, null);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new LocatorException(GetType().Name, typeName, innerException);
			}
			if (obj == null)
			{
				throw new LocatorException(GetType().Name, typeName, null);
			}
			return obj;
		}
	}
	public class LocatorException : Exception
	{
		public LocatorException(string locatorName, string type, Exception innerException)
			: base($"{locatorName} cannot resolve the {type} type. See the inner exception for details.", innerException)
		{
		}
	}
	[DataContract]
	public abstract class BindableBase : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private Dictionary<string, object> _propertyBag;

		private Dictionary<string, object> PropertyBag => _propertyBag ?? (_propertyBag = new Dictionary<string, object>());

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public static string GetPropertyName<T>(Expression<Func<T>> expression)
		{
			return GetPropertyNameFast(expression);
		}

		internal static string GetPropertyNameFast(LambdaExpression expression)
		{
			if (!(expression.Body is MemberExpression { Member: var member }))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("MemberExpression is expected in expression.Body", "expression");
			}
			if (member.MemberType == MemberTypes.Field && member.Name != null && member.Name.StartsWith("$VB$Local_"))
			{
				return member.Name.Substring("$VB$Local_".Length);
			}
			return member.Name;
		}

		protected bool SetProperty<T>(ref T storage, T value, Expression<Func<T>> expression, Action changedCallback)
		{
			return SetProperty(ref storage, value, GetPropertyName(expression), changedCallback);
		}

		protected bool SetProperty<T>(ref T storage, T value, Expression<Func<T>> expression)
		{
			return SetProperty(ref storage, value, expression, null);
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged<T>(Expression<Func<T>> expression)
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged(GetPropertyName(expression));
		}

		protected void RaisePropertiesChanged<T1, T2>(Expression<Func<T1>> expression1, Expression<Func<T2>> expression2)
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression1);
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression2);
		}

		protected void RaisePropertiesChanged<T1, T2, T3>(Expression<Func<T1>> expression1, Expression<Func<T2>> expression2, Expression<Func<T3>> expression3)
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression1);
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression2);
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression3);
		}

		protected void RaisePropertiesChanged<T1, T2, T3, T4>(Expression<Func<T1>> expression1, Expression<Func<T2>> expression2, Expression<Func<T3>> expression3, Expression<Func<T4>> expression4)
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression1);
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression2);
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression3);
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression4);
		}

		protected void RaisePropertiesChanged<T1, T2, T3, T4, T5>(Expression<Func<T1>> expression1, Expression<Func<T2>> expression2, Expression<Func<T3>> expression3, Expression<Func<T4>> expression4, Expression<Func<T5>> expression5)
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression1);
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression2);
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression3);
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression4);
			RaisePropertyChanged(expression5);
		}

		protected T GetProperty<T>(Expression<Func<T>> expression)
		{
			return GetPropertyCore<T>(GetPropertyName(expression));
		}

		protected bool SetProperty<T>(Expression<Func<T>> expression, T value, Action<T> changedCallback)
		{
			string propertyName = GetPropertyName(expression);
			return SetPropertyCore(propertyName, value, changedCallback);
		}

		protected bool SetProperty<T>(Expression<Func<T>> expression, T value)
		{
			return SetProperty(expression, value, (Action)null);
		}

		protected bool SetProperty<T>(Expression<Func<T>> expression, T value, Action changedCallback)
		{
			string propertyName = GetPropertyName(expression);
			return SetPropertyCore(propertyName, value, changedCallback);
		}

		protected virtual bool SetProperty<T>(ref T storage, T value, string propertyName, Action changedCallback)
		{
			VerifyAccess();
			if (CompareValues(storage, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			storage = value;
			RaisePropertyChanged(propertyName);
			changedCallback?.Invoke();
			return true;
		}

		protected bool SetProperty<T>(ref T storage, T value, string propertyName)
		{
			return SetProperty(ref storage, value, propertyName, null);
		}

		protected T GetValue<T>([CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			GuardPropertyName(propertyName);
			return GetPropertyCore<T>(propertyName);
		}

		protected bool SetValue<T>(T value, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			return SetValue(value, (Action)null, propertyName);
		}

		protected bool SetValue<T>(T value, Action changedCallback, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			return SetPropertyCore(propertyName, value, changedCallback);
		}

		protected bool SetValue<T>(T value, Action<T> changedCallback, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			return SetPropertyCore(propertyName, value, changedCallback);
		}

		protected bool SetValue<T>(ref T storage, T value, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			return SetValue(ref storage, value, null, propertyName);
		}

		protected bool SetValue<T>(ref T storage, T value, Action changedCallback, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			GuardPropertyName(propertyName);
			return SetProperty(ref storage, value, propertyName, changedCallback);
		}

		private static void GuardPropertyName(string propertyName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("propertyName");
			}
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertiesChanged((string[])null);
		}

		protected void RaisePropertiesChanged(params string[] propertyNames)
		{
			if (propertyNames == null || propertyNames.Length == 0)
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged(string.Empty);
				return;
			}
			foreach (string propertyName in propertyNames)
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged(propertyName);
			}
		}

		private T GetPropertyCore<T>(string propertyName)
		{
			if (PropertyBag.TryGetValue(propertyName, out var value))
			{
				return (T)value;
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		private bool SetPropertyCore<T>(string propertyName, T value, Action changedCallback)
		{
			T oldValue;
			bool flag = SetPropertyCore(propertyName, value, out oldValue);
			if (flag)
			{
				changedCallback?.Invoke();
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool SetPropertyCore<T>(string propertyName, T value, Action<T> changedCallback)
		{
			T oldValue;
			bool flag = SetPropertyCore(propertyName, value, out oldValue);
			if (flag)
			{
				changedCallback?.Invoke(oldValue);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected virtual bool SetPropertyCore<T>(string propertyName, T value, out T oldValue)
		{
			VerifyAccess();
			oldValue = default(T);
			if (PropertyBag.TryGetValue(propertyName, out var value2))
			{
				oldValue = (T)value2;
			}
			if (CompareValues(oldValue, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			lock (PropertyBag)
			{
				PropertyBag[propertyName] = value;
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged(propertyName);
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void VerifyAccess()
		{
		}

		private static bool CompareValues<T>(T storage, T value)
		{
			return EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(storage, value);
		}
	}

		}

	public static class CollectionBindingHelper
	{
		private sealed class CollectionLocker
		{
			private bool locked;

			public void DoIfNotLocked(Action action)
			{
				if (!locked)
				{
					action();
				}
			}

			public void DoLockedAction(Action action)
			{
				locked = true;
				try
				{
					action();
				}
				finally
				{
					locked = false;
				}
			}

			public void DoLockedActionIfNotLocked(CollectionLocker possibleLocked, Action action)
			{
				possibleLocked.DoIfNotLocked(delegate
				{
					DoLockedAction(action);
				});
			}
		}

		private sealed class CollectionOneWayBinding<TTarget, TSource> : IDisposable
		{
			private CollectionLocker doNotProcessSourceCollectionChanged;

			private CollectionLocker doNotProcessTargetCollectionChanged;

			private Func<TSource, TTarget> itemConverter;

			private bool reverse;

			private readonly bool useStrongReferences;

			private object sourceRef;

			private object targetRef;

			public CollectionOneWayBinding(IEnumerable target, Func<TSource, TTarget> itemConverter, IEnumerable source, CollectionLocker doNotProcessSourceCollectionChanged, CollectionLocker doNotProcessTargetCollectionChanged, bool reverse, bool useStrongReferences)
			{
				source = GetListObject(source);
				this.reverse = reverse;
				this.useStrongReferences = useStrongReferences;
				this.doNotProcessSourceCollectionChanged = doNotProcessSourceCollectionChanged;
				this.doNotProcessTargetCollectionChanged = doNotProcessTargetCollectionChanged;
				sourceRef = (useStrongReferences ? ((object)source) : ((object)new WeakReference(source)));
				targetRef = (useStrongReferences ? ((object)target) : ((object)new WeakReference(target)));
				this.itemConverter = itemConverter;
				if (source is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged += OnSourceCollectionChanged;
				}
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				if ((useStrongReferences ? sourceRef : ((WeakReference)sourceRef).Target) is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
				{
					notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= OnSourceCollectionChanged;
				}
			}

			private IEnumerable<T> ReverseIfNeeded<T>(IEnumerable<T> items)
			{
				if (!reverse)
				{
					return items;
				}
				return items.Reverse();
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				doNotProcessTargetCollectionChanged.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked(doNotProcessSourceCollectionChanged, delegate
				{
					IList<TSource> source = GetSource();
					IList<TTarget> target = GetTarget();
					if (source == null || target == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					target.Clear();
					foreach (TSource item in ReverseIfNeeded(source))
					{
						target.Add(itemConverter(item));
					}
				});
			}

			private void AddCore(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e, IList<TTarget> target)
			{
				int num = (reverse ? (target.Count + 1 - e.NewStartingIndex - e.NewItems.Count) : e.NewStartingIndex);
				foreach (TSource item in ReverseIfNeeded(e.NewItems.Cast<TSource>()))
				{
					target.Insert(num, itemConverter(item));
					num++;
				}
			}

			private void RemoveCore(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e, IList<TTarget> target)
			{
				int num = (reverse ? (target.Count - e.OldStartingIndex - 1) : (e.OldStartingIndex + e.OldItems.Count - 1));
				int num2 = e.OldItems.Count;
				while (--num2 >= 0)
				{
					target.RemoveAt(num);
					num--;
				}
			}

			private void Add(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				doNotProcessTargetCollectionChanged.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked(doNotProcessSourceCollectionChanged, delegate
				{
					IList<TSource> source = GetSource();
					IList<TTarget> target = GetTarget();
					if (source != null && target != null && source.Count != target.Count)
					{
						AddCore(e, target);
					}
				});
			}

			private void Remove(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				doNotProcessTargetCollectionChanged.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked(doNotProcessSourceCollectionChanged, delegate
				{
					IList<TSource> source = GetSource();
					IList<TTarget> target = GetTarget();
					if (source != null && target != null && source.Count != target.Count)
					{
						RemoveCore(e, target);
					}
				});
			}

			private void Move(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				doNotProcessTargetCollectionChanged.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked(doNotProcessSourceCollectionChanged, delegate
				{
					IList<TTarget> target = GetTarget();
					if (target != null)
					{
						RemoveCore(e, target);
						AddCore(e, target);
					}
				});
			}

			private void Replace(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				doNotProcessTargetCollectionChanged.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked(doNotProcessSourceCollectionChanged, delegate
				{
					IList<TSource> source = GetSource();
					IList<TTarget> target = GetTarget();
					if (source == null || target == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					int num = (reverse ? (target.Count - e.NewStartingIndex - e.NewItems.Count) : e.NewStartingIndex);
					foreach (TSource item in ReverseIfNeeded(e.NewItems.Cast<TSource>()))
					{
						target[num] = itemConverter(item);
						num++;
					}
				});
			}

			private void OnSourceCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				IList<TSource> source = GetSource();
				IList<TTarget> target = GetTarget();
				if (target != null)
				{
					switch (e.Action)
					{
					case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
						Add(e);
						break;
					case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
						Remove(e);
						break;
					case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
						Move(e);
						break;
					case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
						Replace(e);
						break;
					default:
						Reset();
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			private IList<TSource> GetSource()
			{
				return GetList<TSource>(useStrongReferences ? sourceRef : ((WeakReference)sourceRef).Target);
			}

			private IList<TTarget> GetTarget()
			{
				return GetList<TTarget>(useStrongReferences ? targetRef : ((WeakReference)targetRef).Target);
			}

			private IList<T> GetList<T>(object listRef)
			{
				if (listRef == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!(listRef is IList<T> result))
				{
					return ListAdapter<T>.FromObjectList((IList)listRef);
				}
				return result;
			}

			private IEnumerable GetListObject(IEnumerable source)
			{
				if (source is IList<TSource> result)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (source is IList result2)
				{
					return result2;
				}
				return source.Cast<TSource>().ToList();
			}
		}

		private sealed class CollectionTwoWayBinding<TTarget, TSource> : IDisposable
		{
			private CollectionOneWayBinding<TTarget, TSource> sourceToTarget;

			private CollectionOneWayBinding<TSource, TTarget> targetToSource;

			public CollectionTwoWayBinding(IEnumerable target, Func<TSource, TTarget> itemConverter, IEnumerable source, Func<TTarget, TSource> itemBackConverter, bool reverse, bool useStrongReferences)
			{
				CollectionLocker collectionLocker = new CollectionLocker();
				CollectionLocker collectionLocker2 = new CollectionLocker();
				targetToSource = new CollectionOneWayBinding<TSource, TTarget>(source, itemBackConverter, target, collectionLocker2, collectionLocker, reverse, useStrongReferences);
				sourceToTarget = new CollectionOneWayBinding<TTarget, TSource>(target, itemConverter, source, collectionLocker, collectionLocker2, reverse, useStrongReferences);
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				sourceToTarget.Reset();
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				sourceToTarget.Dispose();
				sourceToTarget = null;
				targetToSource.Dispose();
				targetToSource = null;
			}
		}

		public static IDisposable BindOneWay<TTarget, TSource>(Func<TSource, TTarget> itemConverter, IList target, IList<TSource> source, bool reverse = false, bool useStrongReferences = false)
		{
			AssertCollections(target, source);
			return BindOneWayCore(target, itemConverter, source, reverse, useStrongReferences);
		}

		public static IDisposable BindOneWay<TTarget, TSource>(IList<TTarget> target, Func<TSource, TTarget> itemConverter, IEnumerable source, bool reverse = false, bool useStrongReferences = false)
		{
			AssertCollections(target, source);
			return BindOneWayCore(target, itemConverter, source, reverse, useStrongReferences);
		}

		public static IDisposable Bind<TTarget, TSource>(Func<TSource, TTarget> itemConverter, IList target, IList<TSource> source, Func<TTarget, TSource> itemBackConverter, bool reverse = false, bool useStrongReferences = false)
		{
			AssertCollections(target, source);
			return BindCore(target, itemConverter, source, itemBackConverter, reverse, useStrongReferences);
		}

		public static IDisposable Bind<TTarget, TSource>(IList<TTarget> target, Func<TSource, TTarget> itemConverter, Func<TTarget, TSource> itemBackConverter, IList source, bool reverse = false, bool useStrongReferences = false)
		{
			AssertCollections(target, source);
			return BindCore(target, itemConverter, source, itemBackConverter, reverse, useStrongReferences);
		}

		public static IDisposable Bind<TTarget, TSource>(Func<TSource, TTarget> itemConverter, IList target, Func<TTarget, TSource> itemBackConverter, IList source, bool reverse = false, bool useStrongReferences = false)
		{
			AssertCollections(target, source);
			return BindCore(target, itemConverter, source, itemBackConverter, reverse, useStrongReferences);
		}

		public static IDisposable Bind<TTarget, TSource>(IList<TTarget> target, Func<TSource, TTarget> itemConverter, IList<TSource> source, Func<TTarget, TSource> itemBackConverter, bool reverse = false, bool useStrongReferences = false)
		{
			AssertCollections(target, source);
			return BindCore(target, itemConverter, source, itemBackConverter, reverse, useStrongReferences);
		}

		private static IDisposable BindCore<TTarget, TSource>(IEnumerable target, Func<TSource, TTarget> itemConverter, IEnumerable source, Func<TTarget, TSource> itemBackConverter, bool reverse, bool useStrongReferences)
		{
